name: description-list
title: Description list
description: Labeled facts about one record, in rows or stacked columns; empty values read as "Not set", and a value may be copyable.

when: The fields of one record on its detail page.

instead.when: Comparing the same fields across records.

builtIn: Uses dl/dt/dd, so each value is read with its label.
An empty value says "Not set" instead of a blank.

genui.description: Labeled facts about one thing, e.g. an order's details.
